content.text:
Text-message notices are now capped at 160 characters, and the full suite passes (63 tests, 0 failures).

The change is in `lib/notices/compose.js`. Every notice is built by `composeNotice`, including hold-ready, due-soon and overdue ones. When a text-message body is longer than 160 characters, it keeps the first 157 and ends with `...`. Email bodies are untouched.

- **Counting:** characters are counted as Unicode characters, so a title with an emoji or other multi-unit character can't be cut in half. For ordinary text this is the same as `length`.
- **Tests:** I added three to `test/notices.test.js`. One checks that an over-long text is cut to 157 characters plus `...`. One checks that exactly 160 characters is left alone. One checks that a long email is never shortened.

My first attempt used a shell heredoc to make the edits, and the permission system blocked it. I redid the work with the file-editing tools. Nothing is committed.
